description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named DigitalWatchFaceCompanionConfigActivity, which provides a UI for configuring settings of a digital watch face companion app. It allows setting background and digit colors, interacts with GoogleApiClient to fetch and send data to the watch device, and handles user interface elements like spinners for color selection.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceCompanionConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android activity facilitating user configuration of watch face settings, such as background and digit colors, by communicating with the watch device via GoogleApiClient and wearable APIs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up GoogleApiClient and retrieves watch face component info.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient connects; retrieves data item from the watch device.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of fetching data item; sets up UI pickers based on config.

methods.name: displayNoConnectedDeviceDialog
methods.description: Shows an alert dialog when no device is connected.

methods.name: setUpAllPickers
methods.description: Configures UI elements based on the current configuration data.

methods.name: setUpColorPickerSelection
methods.description: Sets the initial selection in color spinners based on config or defaults.

methods.name: setUpColorPickerListener
methods.description: Adds listeners to color spinners to send updates when colors are changed.

methods.name: sendConfigUpdateMessage
methods.description: Sends color configuration updates to the watch device.
